body: - **Fake agent:** `viola-fake-agent` (root `[[bin]]`, feature `fake-agent`) replays `fixtures/claude/<cli-version>/<Event>.<variant>.json` (the spine, the `<Event>.<stem>-<n>.json` dialog variants and the `paste-<n>` / `compact-<n>` / `clear-<n>` framing variants and the `SessionStart.resume-1.json` resume variant recorded by `viola verify`, the dialog tier by its Runs C and D, the framing tier by Run B's five added pastes, the resume variant by Run E; `2.1.287`'s four relayed dialog fixtures superseded and kept, `RELAYED.md`), runs absolute exec-form hooks from `<plugin-dir>/hooks/hooks.json` (a group's `matcher` evaluated against a tool-bearing payload's `tool_name`), gates script steps on `--control`, and writes an ndjson `--receipt`; its argv-only `--transcript` creates `<exe dir>/transcripts/` at 0700 at start and gives the launch SessionStart a `transcript_path` to a seeded 0600 file named by its session id (replayed framing variants not rewritten), and every stamping `viola verify` against it (harness `boot` and the stamped-home helpers) passes it `--transcript` beside `--framing` (the framing-free verify helper passes none), and every test-started `viola verify`, `viola run` and `viola revive` and every harness boot stamping runs under a test-owned user home whose config file is seeded empty and owner-only, never the runner's real `HOME` (the harness's supervised wrappers of a stamped session too, under a session user home seeded with an empty config), the fake agent told that config file by `--trust-config` (a `--record` verify keeps the real `HOME` and points a kept `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` at the test-owned user home instead); its print mode `-p/--print <prompt>` fires the four spine fixtures, prints `ok` and exits 0, `--trust-config <file>` reads trust from that config file by the CLI's walk (the canonical cwd's exact key then each parent up to the git root, so inside a repository the cwd's own record counts, through a bounded read; any failure reads untrusted), `--screens` / `--trusted-root` / `--turn-stop` write `Screen.modal|ready|turn` (under `--screens` with an untrusted cwd it draws claude 2.1.325's unnumbered trust form over the set's recorded modal, the selector first on No; arrows move the selector, Enter on No exits 1, and SessionStart fires only after Enter on the trust row, which draws the ready screen), `--dialogs` replays a pasted dialog prompt's recorded variants in claim order, and `--framing` replays Run B's recorded paste, `/compact` and `/clear` variants (the probed `/compact` its recorded `SessionStart.compact-1` with the last fired SessionStart's `session_id`; the exact verify echo probe command, like a stdout-tag local command under `--local-command-mode`, one stdout tag line appended to the last started session's transcript and no hook fired) for verify's six interactive runs (two capped test-only holds: `--stop-receipt-hold-ms`, 1 s, holds the Stop receipt for a race test; `--paste-hint-ms`, 10 s, holds a cleared screen after the long paste's turn; the test-only hold `--trust-record-blank` makes a start trusted by the trust record alone draw no screen, holding verify's Run F window open for a stop case; and the test-only screen switches `--tag-turn-screen <phase>` and `--long-turn-screen <phase>` draw the named screen after the tag-like paste's turn alone and after the long paste's turn alone; under `--screens` a trusted start given `--start-screen <phase>` draws `Screen.<phase>` in place of its ready screen and keeps it standing, each stdin byte one key receipt line, Ctrl-C ending it with no key line, and no byte reaching the input box) (what `viola verify` drives: `tests/cli_verify.rs` pins verify's lines by literal asserts); CI stamps homes only by running `viola verify` against it at the recorded `DEFAULT_CLI_VERSION` 2.1.287 (the root `stamped_home`, each stamped test home a copy, never a link, of one `viola verify` stamp taken per pair of built binaries, kept under `target/e2e-home` keyed by the binaries' hashes and taken under an exclusive lock, and harness `boot` step 4, unless `--unstamped`; `StampedHome::unstamped` for the unverified-path tests; `SessionOptions::unstamped`, default false, the in-test form of `boot --unstamped` for a harness session); the real `claude` never runs in CI — only the local `run --local-live`, refused under `CI` (`live-in-ci`), and the live starts of the one standing test-only rig `viola-live-rig` in viola-e2e, run by hand under the founder's start cap for each chunk, each ledgered with its clock time first, its live arm refused under CI and its rehearsals over the fake agent run in CI — and neither does the real `hyprctl`, which the same fake agent stands in for as `hyprctl` by its own file name in a test-scoped bin dir, reading its mode and reply set from files beside its exe, except in viola-hyprland's own unit tests, which serve `hyprctl` by a planted shell stub because cargo-mutants runs only the mutated package's tests, so a root-package test cannot kill that crate's mutants. The committed `fixtures/claude/*/*.json` (sets `2.1.283`, `2.1.287`, `2.1.288`, `2.1.302` and `2.1.325`, 12 dialog variants each in 2.1.287, 2.1.288, 2.1.302 and 2.1.325, six framing variants, one resume variant and one agents fixture (`Agents.recorded-1.json`, Run B's own row of its one `claude agents --json` read) in each of 2.1.287, 2.1.302 and 2.1.325, and 2.1.287's superseded relayed fixtures included; 2.1.287, 2.1.302 and 2.1.325 stamped at every relied row, all 24 on every build, 2.1.283 and 2.1.288 drift-only) are walked for hygiene by a run-time directory walk against `schemas/claude-fixture.v1.json`, the `Agents.*.json` agents fixtures against `schemas/claude-agents-fixture.v1.json` (`agents_fixtures_pass_hygiene`), the `Mcp.*.json` MCP exchanges (`Mcp.tools-list-1.json` in 2.1.302 and 2.1.325, recorded by the test-only `viola-mcp-tap`) left out of that walk and walked by `mcp_fixtures` against `schemas/claude-mcp-fixture.v1.json` (`mcp_fixtures_pass_hygiene`), then replayed against `viola mcp` by `mcp_recorded_exchange` (the served `tools/list` result holding the recorded key and type shape and tool names in order), the `Screen.*.json` screens apart against `schemas/claude-screen.v1.json` (email and row-seam usernames refused too, and a box prompt row with text after the prompt char or a box rule row with any other text: a box row is recorded as its literal alone, `planted_box_row_beyond_its_literal_is_rejected`) (rstest 0.27 `#[files]` refuses an empty glob at compile time); the same walk drives the drift contract `contract_fake_agent_drift`, which compares each print-mode hook's receipt `stdin_hex` byte for byte with the recorded fixture and the hook order with the spine literal, and replays every dialog variant and every framing variant byte for byte, and replays the resume variant (`fake_agent_resume_replay_matches_every_recorded_resume_set`) and, once resumed into its own session, the compact variant (`fake_agent_compact_replay_matches_every_recorded_compact_set`), and compares the key and type shape of the fake agent's `agents` rows with each recorded `Agents.*.json` set (`fake_agent_agents_replay_matches_every_recorded_agents_set`) (the resume launch: under `--resume <id>`, one of thirteen argv options (`--settings <file>` accepted, its value consumed and ignored; beside the options the mode word `agents`, a first word `agents` answering `agents --json` from files beside its exe (`agents-mode`, `agents-rows.json` and the live `sessions/<pid>.json` registry), built on the recorded `Agents.recorded-1.json`, with no option and no env added), the launch SessionStart is the set's recorded `SessionStart.resume-1.json` when the set holds it (2.1.287 and 2.1.302, recorded by Run E since chunk 2026-10-14-resume-and-compact-ledger-rows), else its recorded default (a set without the variant, 2.1.288), with `source` `resume` and that `session_id`, or with `--fork-session` the compiled fork id; the `--resume` shape is the `resume-session` ledger row) ; the committed Hyprland fixtures (recorded only by the test-only `viola-hypr-tap`, under the same scrub) are walked for hygiene and against their schema too, each Hyprland reply held to its closed per-request string keep-list — no insta snapshot

Two live starts were spent (R4 24/24 green with browser-tools-prompt absent and Run E box; R4M green); no byte went into any CLI dialog and nothing was written under the real home.
No product crate, no viola output, refusal, exit code, schema or CI workflow changed; only the test-only e2e crate, one e2e probe list and the fixtures moved.

body:
The session landed a fifth recorded claude fixture set, for claude 2.1.325, recorded live by the test-only rig under its private CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR with the browser-tools key seeded off, not a reading of a real home.
The test-only live rig gained two arms: VR (labels R4 and R4-2) keeps the recorder's scrubbed record at 0600 beside its frames and refuses, uncounted with exit 3 and the word record-home, a scratch base naming a home component; MT (label R4M) starts claude -p with the test-only MCP tap in front of viola mcp and writes the tap's fixture.
The rig's summary gained closed words: record, mcp-child, stdout-bytes, stderr-bytes, stderr-sha, capture-lines, tap-fixture; MT drops the child's stdout and only counts and hashes its stderr.
The ledger probe suite's stamped sets moved from 2 to 3 (2.1.287, 2.1.302, 2.1.325); the drift, ledger-probe and recorded MCP exchange suites now read the new set.
Only the test-only crate viola-e2e changed; no product crate, no viola format or schema, no diagnostics line, span, metric or CI workflow changed; CI on the pushed head is green 7/7.

body: The rule that recorded claude fixtures are no telemetry source: a new recorded set landed, written by the recorders and the tap from a live start, never derived from diagnostics lines.

The rule that claude fixtures are scrub-required: the 2.1.325 set is the recorders' and the tap's scrubbed output, passed the fixture hygiene walk and an identity read; landed at mode 0644 after being kept at 0600.

The rule that real-CLI verify never runs in CI and CI verifies against the fake agent only: the live R4 start ran viola verify against real claude 2.1.325 by path in a local live round, not in CI; the rehearsals in CI use the fake agent.
The rules that wrapped claude internals and transcripts are not a contract: the set records claude 2.1.325's hook payloads and MCP exchange as test fixtures only.

The rules over viola mcp's stdout carrying frames only and its stdin bounded by MAX_FRAME: the MT arm puts the test-only tap in front of viola mcp and records its exchange; the rig's own reads of the record and capture are bounded through MAX_FRAME.

The rules that stripped CLAUDE environment values and the child's env are never logged: the MT arm spawns claude -p with the rig's child env and private CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, its stdout dropped and stderr only counted and hashed.
The rule that the browser-tools prompt reading is uninstrumented: R4 read browser-tools-prompt absent on 2.1.325 with the browser-tools key seeded off.
The rules that verify log lines carry no content and verify logs only inside an instance: the R4 start ran viola verify under the rig's private vhome, 24 of 24 ledger rows.

The rules that local run outputs are never uploaded and test homes sit under the scanned root: the rig's kept record dir target/live-rig/<label>/record/ is gitignored with the frames and stays local; the MT arm's 0600 mcp.json lives in its scratch and is removed with it.
The rule that drift reports go to diagnostics only: the drift suites now read the 2.1.325 set; no drift report path changed.
The rules naming the components left uninstrumented: the test-only rig and the tap stay outside product telemetry; their summary words are a closed test-harness vocabulary, not diagnostics lines.
Any row whose cell holds the count of recorded sets under the fixtures or the stamped sets the ledger probes read: the recorded sets moved 4 to 5, the stamped sets 2 to 3.

The Linux-only target and the hand read of the token window: the live round ran on the Linux host; the builder read the real credentials file's expiry once by hand outside the rig, nothing kept or logged.
The product diagnostics line schema, its field names, event enum, detail codes and process-exit codes: no product crate and no emitted line changed.
Span and trace coverage, span names, attributes and kinds of viola run, send, wait, dialog and hook paths: no span changed.
Metric coverage, derived counters, gauges and histograms, and the SLO and perf budgets of the hooks: no budget or threshold moved.
Error capture and panic handling by role, the panic hook, catch sites and the detail-file error line: unchanged.
PII scrubbing of diagnostics lines, veil redaction, the field allow-list and the secret-scan hit report: unchanged.
CI integration gates, the schema conformance, zero-panics and bare-instrument gates, artifact retention and the CI workflow: no gate or workflow changed.
The channel, send, wait, link and wheel log contracts, the heartbeat, config.json keys and the agent-run logs and status contracts: unchanged.
The logging stack, subscriber, log file locations, modes and home resolution of the product roles: unchanged.

body:
The session landed the claude 2.1.325 recorded fixture set (28 files) from two live starts of the test-only live rig on 2.1.325 by path, under the rig's private CLI config with the browser-tools key seeded off.
It added two live-rig arms in the test-only e2e crate: VR (labels R4 and R4-2), the verify start whose recorded set is kept, and MT (label R4M), one direct claude -p start with the test-only MCP tap placed in front of viola mcp.
VR refuses, uncounted and before any ledger line, a scratch base whose path or canonical form names a component exactly home (refused: record-home, exit 3); it copies the record byte for byte at 0600, never overwrites, and leaves first-screen captures out.
MT writes a private 0600 mcp.json inside its scratch, removed with it; CLI stdout is drained and dropped, stderr is only counted and hashed; the tap's fixture step runs bounded with only PATH and HOME in its env.
The stamped recorded sets read by the 24-row ledger probes grew from 2 to 3 (2.1.287, 2.1.302, 2.1.325); the recorded sets under the fixture tree grew from 4 to 5. No product crate, viola format or schema changed; CI on the pushed head is green 7/7.
The founder moved the StopFailure payload out of this fixture set to its own entry, A live StopFailure payload; the provisional StopFailure exception stays as it stands, only its owner moves.

Two live starts were spent on claude 2.1.325 by path: R4, a clean viola verify --record at 24/24 with failing none, and R4M, the MCP tap re-record; the spare R4-2 was not used.
The live rig gained two arms: VR, a verify whose record is kept, and MT, a direct claude -p start with the test-only MCP tap in front of viola mcp. It also gained the labels R4, R4-2 and R4M, and a kept record dir under target/live-rig/<label>/record/.
